title: A Pickpocket Stole My Wallet on the Train 👛
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #train #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: I was on a packed train when I felt it. A hand slipping into my bag.
scenes.image: crowded subway train interior, a sneaky pickpocket about 35 with a flat cap and a long coat sliding a hand into the tote bag of a calm young woman about 28 with a bob haircut and a tote bag

scenes.text: I didn't move. I didn't scream. I just smiled.
scenes.image: close-up of a calm young woman about 28 with a bob haircut and a tote bag smiling calmly, eyes half closed

scenes.text: At the next stop, he jumped off with my wallet, grinning like he'd won the lottery.
scenes.image: a sneaky pickpocket about 35 with a flat cap and a long coat hopping off the train onto a platform, holding a pink wallet, grinning

scenes.text: He opened it on the platform. No money. No cards. Just a little note.
scenes.image: a sneaky pickpocket about 35 with a flat cap and a long coat opening the wallet on the platform and finding only a folded note

scenes.text: It said: This wallet is empty. I'm a pickpocket too.
scenes.image: close-up of a handwritten note held by a sneaky pickpocket about 35 with a flat cap and a long coat, his face confused

scenes.text: He laughed. Then the note said, check your coat pocket.
scenes.image: a sneaky pickpocket about 35 with a flat cap and a long coat frowning, slowly reaching into his coat

scenes.text: His own wallet was gone. He looked up. The train doors were closing.
scenes.image: a sneaky pickpocket about 35 with a flat cap and a long coat patting his empty coat pockets in panic as train doors close

scenes.text: And through the window, I waved his wallet at him. Lesson one: never steal from a professional.
scenes.image: a calm young woman about 28 with a bob haircut and a tote bag inside the departing train waving a brown wallet through the window, winking
